description: This file implements input/output functionalities for TunerStudio integration, handling serial and USB connections, DMA configurations, and data communication routines within firmware.

methods.name: startTsPort
methods.description: Initializes the TunerStudio communication port, selecting between USB, UART, and simulator modes depending on configuration.

methods.name: stopTsPort
methods.description: Stops the active TunerStudio communication port, disabling UART or USB as applicable.

methods.name: sr5WriteData
methods.description: Sends data through the active TunerStudio port, handling DMA or serial transmission.

methods.name: sr5ReadDataTimeout
methods.description: Reads data from the port with a specified timeout, using DMA buffer or UART as configured.

methods.name: sr5ReadData
methods.description: Reads data with a default timeout.

methods.name: sr5WriteCrcPacket
methods.description: Creates and sends a packet with CRC for integrity, including size, command, and CRC footer.

methods.name: sr5SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message, with optional CRC based on mode.

methods.name: sr5IsReady
methods.description: Checks if the TunerStudio port is ready based on current configuration.
